title: Members CLI for the waitlist and enablement
description:
**Phase 3 of 7.** Off the critical path. Let it slip if capacity is short.

- **Blocked by:** b574a6
- **Runs in parallel with:** every other phase-3 task
- **Unblocks:** nothing

---
python -m chatticus.members with list --status pending, enable, suspend, and role. This is the admin surface for v1; there is no admin UI. Organization records are data, not infrastructure, so writing them from a CLI does not violate the CDK-only rule for AWS resources.

**Done when:** an operator can list pending organizations and enable one against development.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
**Adversarial review: this is no longer allowed to slip.**

The description says off the critical path, let it slip if capacity is short. That was wrong. 5744ef establishes that the members CLI is the only way to enable the first organization, so it is the bootstrap path for every environment, and enforcement in 7b4616 cannot land without it.

Priority raised to P0. Treat the earlier slack note as withdrawn.
